items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, these were the gigs with Elmer Snowden. I just gigged with Elmer Snowden, you know.

ctx.x: Elmer. Elmer didn't want to go on the road, because he always told me -- he say, "You are my next tenor player." He always kept me in mind.
He say, "Yeah, I'll keep you in mind, man. Like if anything happen -- if Elmer leave or something like that, you got his job."
